blurb: Guests play on a par 70, 18-hole golf course with scenic views and a unique century-old chimney on the 18th hole. The club features a 10-station driving range, chipping and putting greens, and a full-service bar and restaurant called The Greenhill Pub. It also offers banquet spaces for events and hosts golf outings and tournaments.
